analysis.ratio: Each ESTA R/P/Y rate error RMSE <= 1.25 times three PID median in hover, tracking and each of the three fixed phases; this includes all non-commanded axes. No adaptive noise floor.
analysis.other_metrics: height error, wrapped yaw attitude error, cross-axis rate and command response, all-axis saturation, atomic nu updates and exact PID yaw output
analysis.roll_regression: Retain original M04 trigger=1 scene and AXES=1, one PID and one ESTA run; report separately.

scope: Iris nominal development only. Each failed/tuning attempt retained. Not independent paired random trials or held-out paper evaluation.
